title: Unique strongboxes with Jado
summary: Jado's Trove Seekers doubles the chance for strongboxes to be unique and Stolen Relics adds the Twilight Reliquary Key box; Overseer tablets, The Chosen Path and Overlord's Influence add more strongboxes.

budget.build_needs: Survives strongbox guard packs and their strongbox modifiers.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Stolen Relics: Unique Strongboxes may be the Legacy of the Order, which contains 1 additional Twilight Reliquary Key.
Mysterious Gifts: Rare Strongbox Monsters have 5% chance to drop a Cryptic Key.

nodes.name: Trove Seekers
nodes.effect: 100% increased amount of Rare Chests; Strongboxes have 100% increased chance to be Unique

nodes.name: Mysterious Gifts
nodes.effect: Unique Monsters have 1% chance to drop a Cryptic Key; Rare Strongbox Monsters have 5% chance to drop a Cryptic Key

nodes.name: Stolen Relics
nodes.effect: Unique Strongboxes may be the Legacy of the Order, dropping a Twilight Reliquary Key

atlas_master.alt: Doryani T3 Mechanical Guardians: non-unique strongboxes are guarded by a dormant Construct and have 2% increased Item Quantity per Modifier.

claim.note: All three nodes name strongboxes directly (poe2db); the combination is our synthesis. Not measured.

atlas_passives.name: The Chosen Path
atlas_passives.effect: 100% increased chance of a certain content type — take Strongboxes

atlas_passives.name: Overlord's Influence
atlas_passives.effect: Add additional content to areas with Powerful Map Bosses — options: 1 additional Strongboxes, Shrines or Azmeri Spirits. Take Strongboxes.

atlas_passives.name: Hidden Compartments
atlas_passives.effect: Strongboxes have 15% chance to be openable twice

atlas_passives.name: An Appropriate Vault
atlas_passives.effect: Strongboxes have 2% increased Item Quantity per Modifier

mods.text: Map has (70–100)% increased chance to contain Strongboxes

waystone.notes: Strongbox contents are rolled by the box; map item rarity is an assumed, unmeasured bonus.

claim.note: Editorial; no source says waystone item rarity changes strongbox contents.

steps: Set Jado: Trove Seekers, Mysterious Gifts, Stolen Relics.
Allocate The Chosen Path and Overlord's Influence on Strongboxes, then Hidden Compartments.
Slot an Overseer Tablet with additional strongboxes or strongbox chance.
Open every strongbox; use Cryptic Keys to reopen the good ones.
risks: Unique strongbox contents are random (for example Ixchel's Torment grants a corrupted unique); the basket prices only the keys.
Overlord's Influence adds content only where the Map Boss is Powerful.
